title: DINNER LADY 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid – Cola Shades – Summer Holidays Series
description:
Cola Ice is part of Dinner Lady’s award-winning Ice Range made of sweet soda with cool citrus at the end! If you can’t resist Cola, this is full of authentic cola flavour and finished off with a fizz of lemon, a flavour that is sure to keep refreshed throughout the day.
Cola Shades by Dinner Lady comes in 50ml bottles with 10ml space to add in your nicotine shot, with 70% VG you can use this liquid in any sub-ohm device.
Flavour:
Cola
Lemon
VG/PG:
70% VG, 30% PG
Bottle size:
60ml filled with 50ml for your nicotine shot.
Nicotine Levels:
Zero – 0mg/ml
